The '''Deep Wilderness Dungeon''' can be found in level 51 [[Wilderness]]. The entrance is via stairs in a broken house west of the [[Mage Arena]]. It is entirely [[single-way combat]] and covers level 49 to 56 Wilderness.
{{Map|3045,3925|r=4|mtype=square|align=left|width=250|height=250|caption=The entrance to the Deep Wilderness Dungeon on the map.}}

The main attractions here are the [[wine of Zamorak]] spawn found at the end of the dungeon, which respawns every 3-7 ticks (and are obtained in noted form if players have completed the [[hard Wilderness Diary]]), as well as the [[fire giant]]s which can be assigned as a Wilderness [[Slayer task]] by [[Krystilia]], this being their only location in the Wilderness. A cannon can be used within the dungeon.

Approximately 9-14 [[wine of Zamorak]] per minute (540-840 per hour) can be obtained here, accounting for respawn times and the [[telekinetic grab]] animation. Note that unlike other [[wine of Zamorak]] spawns, killing the [[monks of Zamorak]] here does not allow a player to pick up the wines without [[telekinetic grab]]. A crevice can be found near the staircase, requiring level 46 [[Agility]] and completion of the [[medium Wilderness Diary]], that will take the player directly to the fire giant area.

There is also a [[grimy guam leaf]] and an [[attack potion(1)]] that [[Item spawn|spawns]] in the dungeon.

Players who are planning on killing fire giants that do not have access to the crevice shortcut are advised to bring [[prayer potion]]s as the [[shadow spider]]s along the way will drain half of the player's current [[Prayer]] points when combat is initiated and at regular intervals. Alternatively initiating combat with a [[Chaos dwarf]] while walking through the [[shadow spider]]s will prevent initiating combat due to being [[single-way combat]].

==Transportation==
There are several ways to reach the deep wilderness dungeon:
* Casting [[Ice Plateau Teleport]] and running East, requiring level 89 [[Magic]] and costing 3 [[Law rune|law]], 3 [[Astral rune|astral]] and 8 [[water rune]]s. The dungeon entrance is approximately 90 tiles from the teleport location. Note that the teleport location features aggressive level 57 [[ice warrior]]s.
* Using the [[Lever_(Deserted_Keep)|wilderness lever]] from [[Edgeville]] or [[Ardougne]] and running West past the [[Mage Arena]], approximately 150 tiles in total. This route requires a [[knife]] or a [[Slash weapons|slash weapon]] to cut the web at the edge of the [[Deserted Keep]].
* Running from the level 44 [[wilderness obelisk]] - first North to the gate on the Western edge of the [[wilderness fence]], and then East to the entrance, is approximately 175 tiles.

The fastest way to leave the wilderness from the deep wilderness dungeon is to run East to the [[Mage Arena bank]], from which players can teleport as normal. This route requires a [[knife]] or a [[Slash weapons|slash weapon]] to cut the web at the bank's entrance.
